description: Issue #181 meeting Issue #177: the deny-by-default boundary around the agent harness must not acquire a second, quieter door on the profile side. #177 keeps `.claude/skills/` / `.agents/skills/` / `.commandmate/` out of `scope.allow` unless the ISSUE names the path under a deliverable heading — a grant that is explicit and reported as `harness_path_in_scope` — and its rationale says in as many words that a `scope_companions`-style key must not be able to relax it. A literal companion is exactly such a key, and it is statically decidable, so it is refused at profile load (load_error, exit 6) rather than dropped at derivation: a rule that never lands is a rule that never says so, and the profile is a reviewed artifact whose author can fix it. The escape hatch is unchanged and stays in the issue body, where the warning is attached.
